# Parse the file content to extract song titles and artists.
import re
lines = file_content['content'].strip().split('\n')
songs_to_archive = []
for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    # Format: "- Title by Artist"
    m = re.match(r'^- (.+) by (.+)$', line)
    if m:
        title = m.group(1).strip()
        artist = m.group(2).strip()
        songs_to_archive.append({'title': title, 'artist': artist})
print(songs_to_archive)
